title: Stopping criteria in structural reliability analysis: An overview
abstract: arXiv:2611.31706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stopping criteria have become a crucial component of probabilistic and statistical methods in structural reliability analysis, helping prevent structural defects and failures, as well as inaccurate evaluations of existing structures. Over time, these rules have evolved in both concept and application, whereas their treatment in the literature remains fragmented. They are often developed and presented in connection with specific models or analytical frameworks, obscuring their broader applicability across diverse models and methodologies. On this basis, the aim of this article is twofold. First, it overviews a wide range of stopping rules, drawing on concepts from applied probability and statistics. These strategies include classical methods based on error estimates or variance, and stability detection. While many of these ideas were developed in other fields, they have the potential to offer useful tools for structural reliability task

translated_title: 结构可靠性分析中的停止准则：综述
translated_abstract: 停止准则已成为结构可靠性分析中概率与统计方法的关键组成部分，有助于防止结构缺陷与失效，以及对现有结构的不准确评估。随着时间推移，这些准则在概念和应用上都不断发展演变，但文献中对它们的处理仍然零散。这些准则往往与特定模型或分析框架相结合进行开发和呈现，从而掩盖了其在不同模型和方法之间更广泛的适用性。基于此，本文的目标有两个方面。首先，文章借鉴应用概率与统计中的概念，对广泛的停止规则进行了综述。这些策略包括基于误差估计或方差以及稳定性检测的经典方法。虽然其中许多思想源自其他领域，但它们有潜力为结构可靠性任务提供有用的工具。
tldr: 本文系统综述了结构可靠性分析中各类停止准则，指出基于误差估计、方差和稳定性检测的经典方法虽源自其他领域，但在结构可靠性分析中具有广泛的适用性和应用潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a systematic overview of stopping criteria in structural reliability analysis, highlighting that classical rules from other fields—based on error estimates, variance, and stability detection—have broad applicability and potential as useful tools for structural reliability tasks.
